fusions.name: Gavel Blow
fusions.desc: Brings a heavy paw down on the target for 16 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at maximum range, and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Decree of Ruin
fusions.desc: Crashes down on every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 28 damage. Your allies strike 20% harder for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Royal Rally
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 20% harder for 12 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Standing Orders
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner. Your armour rises by 8%.
